name: digest-group
title: Digest Group
description: One group in a digest: title and count, an urgent mark, a header extra, one group action, the caller's rows and a controlled Show N more footer.

meta.whenToUse: A group of rows in a digest or summary: Overdue, Due this week, Waiting on others.
meta.whenNotToUse: A plain list with no group action or paging (ItemGroup), or a table (DataList).
